::: {.callout-note}
## Expanded Version Available

This blog post has been expanded into a comprehensive exposition covering brane tilings, 4D N=1 SCFTs, orientifold projections, brane bending, Seiberg duality, and connections to geometric engineering.

**[Read the full Notes page on Brane Tilings and SCFTs →](../notes/brane-tilings.qmd)**
:::

The original post introduced brane tilings as bipartite graphs on a torus, walked through orientifold projections, and presented a worked example for the Z3 orbifold. The expanded version adds detailed treatments of 4D superconformal field theories, the mechanism of deconfining N=2 theories via brane bending, S-duality and Seiberg duality, and connections to Heidenreich's program on geometric engineering.
